items.description: Free BAC calculator. Add beers, wine, spirits or cocktails in one tap and estimate your blood alcohol and when it'll be back to zero.

items.markdown:
You can estimate alcohol elimination and blood alcohol concentration (BAC) using the [BAC Calculator](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXjEhwwpWtnFVzo3Dv0BAWOIJXq8mG0MbSTqxI2Aj31QOP5yMut7HU4zKokmHTcloBeLrVDsXWeV_yOxdhhvTi_pxFCLUWNSVexxh_FdDX0BrjSs7OFzqJiOeegBFLLKEHlY61hOql) , which takes your sex, body weight, time elapsed, and drink amounts to estimate your BAC. For clinical or toxic alcohol serum estimates based on volume and percentage ingested, you can also use the Estimated Ethanol (and Toxic Alcohol) Serum Concentration Based on Ingestion Calculator.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXjEhwwpWtnFVzo3Dv0BAWOIJXq8mG0MbSTqxI2Aj31QOP5yMut7HU4zKokmHTcloBeLrVDsXWeV_yOxdhhvTi_pxFCLUWNSVexxh_FdDX0BrjSs7OFzqJiOeegBFLLKEHlY61hOql)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF17AfFYh_ipLewQCVWDqDHlFjh_t0jWddngz39wfL27CGtbIJcNooHO8OF3jGuCbvhuRq2rna38k94wX9D55dArclHGSXQwU1zkereRCW4v9jIrRAWcqTlIGWkmUbm9uuWES73bCzEv0KLuOK1YQn_8dGavH23tya423ieiKd-T2_w_BiLYmgqibN_BJE830XGTtr4D8SU4aXUFhzqQ)

### How Alcohol Metabolism Works

- **Elimination rate:** On average, the body eliminates alcohol at about **0.015% to 0.016% BAC per hour** , roughly equal to **one standard drink per hour**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXcS1No3krN2Y9DWLz2UqkHDRQRCW9zYB4xZ8-P1dmqWU8JIgL8QzENHy9L1Cns3ASTsvOyQ-rYUg_Mnh-BZeC2jvneQQzRTx0PpmRChxR24I7Kkuhlw9AwIAUvi8WYh3BeQvzfG_Qms4Gtwd9HA-5xQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX-3_Pm-cEmhRG2wxErNcJDFgxQXqqorsUrJ2s5JrZ-nGY1y_csByHhSi7jsYFjeoOWtas-nslBpIDdCtd59JqMaKyk_zIen68wrXGu-i0m5Tk89x0fzhU42g3bxypSzfX_VnaDeQdx6EPy2I)
- **Absorption timing:** Alcohol typically takes **30 to 70 minutes** after drinking to reach peak levels in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXcS1No3krN2Y9DWLz2UqkHDRQRCW9zYB4xZ8-P1dmqWU8JIgL8QzENHy9L1Cns3ASTsvOyQ-rYUg_Mnh-BZeC2jvneQQzRTx0PpmRChxR24I7Kkuhlw9AwIAUvi8WYh3BeQvzfG_Qms4Gtwd9HA-5xQ)
- **No shortcuts:** Coffee, cold showers, food, or extra water do not speed up liver metabolism; only time lowers BAC.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXg1swMtwIWmxEhCOXwaLqV6tmrcccyqUWcsEMgvjZLnblwXB55D5nHRUocrSttzvfaUak9_yCiINgPWwAMAoYTwLRdtanhEwJ46XLxbMkoNpD8wZF-UXIjPniTg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX-3_Pm-cEmhRG2wxErNcJDFgxQXqqorsUrJ2s5JrZ-nGY1y_csByHhSi7jsYFjeoOWtas-nslBpIDdCtd59JqMaKyk_zIen68wrXGu-i0m5Tk89x0fzhU42g3bxypSzfX_VnaDeQdx6EPy2I)
- **Estimates only:** Calculators rely on averages and do not account for individual differences like food intake, liver health, medications, or tolerance. Do not use a calculator to judge whether you are safe to drive.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1yFFmUUfrgolrww1LlByN0v0v70IZcwhzmVCu6zS8UoH-uqk93WC3iS3jCk_r7nB65EzRXurDgl2cg71aJ0eD_kbWpqCt6SBBCcg0l4lFIqrjh8B1MALWxbVNfOxrC8T6TmW-TQyvkAOUvfq0jc4K9B8OIxRZpHSEc-n_CqHk45FiCIzNOM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXg1swMtwIWmxEhCOXwaLqV6tmrcccyqUWcsEMgvjZLnblwXB55D5nHRUocrSttzvfaUak9_yCiINgPWwAMAoYTwLRdtanhEwJ46XLxbMkoNpD8wZF-UXIjPniTg)

### Standard Drink Equivalents (U.S.)
One U.S. standard drink contains about **14 grams (0.6 fl oz)** of pure alcohol:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXBZmwQisGeRq2Ihu4qFDdgUXGDQPlgpJ0l7S0kj9I9qOIgCwWfTPdfEwqmGd7sDDOE16nxZebH1hZBwVmEQy92_aD4E4xfFFqEbjXOJz7WP00yWhGzNJqrw1fvkomy8MzJ_syNcX7jQiJPocDtPzZTcDxIhjEEzcsPg)

- **Beer:** 12 fl oz at ~5% ABV
- **Table wine:** 5 fl oz at ~12% ABV
- **Distilled spirits:** 1.5 fl oz shot at 40% ABV (80 proof)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXBZmwQisGeRq2Ihu4qFDdgUXGDQPlgpJ0l7S0kj9I9qOIgCwWfTPdfEwqmGd7sDDOE16nxZebH1hZBwVmEQy92_aD4E4xfFFqEbjXOJz7WP00yWhGzNJqrw1fvkomy8MzJ_syNcX7jQiJPocDtPzZTcDxIhjEEzcsPg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXcS1No3krN2Y9DWLz2UqkHDRQRCW9zYB4xZ8-P1dmqWU8JIgL8QzENHy9L1Cns3ASTsvOyQ-rYUg_Mnh-BZeC2jvneQQzRTx0PpmRChxR24I7Kkuhlw9AwIAUvi8WYh3BeQvzfG_Qms4Gtwd9HA-5xQ)

If you want to run a specific estimate, share your **approximate weight**, **sex**, **drink types and amounts** , and **hours since your first drink** . We can also explore **how individual factors affect metabolism** or **standard drink sizing**.
